pattern = re.compile(r'^- (\w+) paid \$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) for "(.+?)"\. Owed equally by (.+)$')

    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=nid, access_token=simple_note_login['access_token'])

        payer_first = m.group(1)
        amount = float(m.group(2))
        description = m.group(3)
        debtors_str = m.group(4)
        # Split debtors by comma and strip
